<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Special Parliament session:</strong> The Union government is considering a special session to pass the Women’s Reservation Bill and address potential delimitation to increase Lok Sabha seats to 850, though the Opposition has criticized the lack of consultation and transparency regarding the agenda.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNbUw5MnNEbDkwcXNmZkFtMGpZZEpTZjhPSTRmYUtNWjhFTG9qbUU4ZmtraDZlQTV0XzN3Rm9NNU5ZaEdGZU94Wm9Ka0cxTHJJYWNOdGtoNEN4MU1MbWhPQXd2alBrTXJpOFo3eDVRYmRha3B6QXV2THlyUkt1OXItWTBnd0EzcDQ4OUtIYk8xbEItQ0E0SW9QWjhmUU1ySHZtMHQ5M25vUGRaNWoyREJLc3Z1ekY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Constitutional debate:</strong> Prime Minister Modi and opposition leaders, including Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, have engaged in a heated exchange regarding the protection of democracy and the Constitution, with the PM accusing the opposition of misusing these institutions for political gain.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Diplomatic policy:</strong> The Ministry of External Affairs has signaled that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann must adhere to national policy regarding his proposed trip to Lahore following a foreign invitation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>

<ul class="digest-points">
